p: own hearts: After their own fantasy and not as having the revelation of the Lord, Jer 23:16.
in the deserts: Watching to destroy the vineyard.
Ye have not gone up into: He speaks to the governor and true ministers that would have resisted them.
ye say: You promised peace to this people and now you see their destruction, so that it is revealed that you are false prophets.
writing of the house of Israel: That is in the book of life, in which the true Israelites are written.

wall: While the true prophets prophesied the destruction of the city to bring the people to repentance, the false prophets spoke the contrary, and flattered them in their vanities, so that what one false prophet said (which is here called the building of the wall) another false prophet would affirm, though he had neither opportunity nor good ground to hear him.
untempered mortar: By which is meant whatever man of himself sets forth under the authority of God's word.

magic charms upon all wrists: These superstitious women for money would prophecy and tell every man his fortune giving them pillows to lean on, and kerchiefs to cover their heads, to the intent they might the more allure them and bewitch them.
barley and for pieces of bread: Will you make my word serve your bellies?
to save the souls alive that: These sorcerers made the people believe that they could preserve life or destroy it and that it would come to everyone according as they prophesied.
souls to make them fly: That is, to cause them to perish, and that they should depart from the body.
righteous sad: By threatening them that were godly, and upholding the wicked.
